# git is a hard requirement: sesam shells out to it for every repo-backed
# command, so without git on $PATH they must fail with a clear error.

exec git init
exec git config user.email test@sesam.dev
exec git config user.name 'Sesam Test'

exec sesam init --user admin
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'init sesam'

# hide-git keeps only the directory holding the sesam test binary on $PATH.
hide-git
! exec git --version

! exec sesam status
stderr 'executable file not found'

! exec sesam log
stderr 'executable file not found'
